item.title: Residents raise health concerns as Savusavu landfill fire continues
item.description: Residents in Savusavu are raising concerns about their health as the fire at the Savusavu landfill continues to burn, with smoke affecting parts of the town. Some residents claim the landfill has been burning for the past five days, sending thick smoke across parts of Savusavu, including nearby schools, resorts and the marina.
item.content:encoded:
Residents in Savusavu are raising concerns about their health as the fire at the Savusavu landfill continues to burn, with smoke affecting parts of the town.

Some residents claim the landfill has been burning for the past five days, sending thick smoke across parts of Savusavu, including nearby schools, resorts and the marina.

They say many parents have kept their children home from school, while some people have reported sore throats, coughing, runny noses and itchy eyes, which they believe are linked to the smoke.

Residents also say the smoke affected the youth rugby tournament held over the weekend.

They claim this is not the first time the landfill has caught fire but describe the current incident as the worst they have experienced.

Meanwhile, the Ministry of Local Government says the National Fire Authority, in collaboration with the Savusavu Town Council, is actively managing and suppressing a subterranean fire at the landfill.

The Ministry says firefighters extinguished the surface-level flames yesterday, but the fire originated deep underground and requires heavy machinery to fully eliminate the threat.

It says a digger has been deployed to excavate the affected area while firefighters remain on standby to extinguish underground hotspots as they are exposed.

The Savusavu Town Council is expected to comment later.

item.title: 20-yr-old charged with murder of a 77-yr-old man in Nadi
item.description: A 20-year-old man has been charged with one count of murder for allegedly causing the death of a 77-year-old man. He will appear in the Nadi Magistrates Court today charged.
item.content:encoded:
A 20-year-old man has been charged with one count of murder for allegedly causing the death of a 77-year-old man.

He will appear in the Nadi Magistrates Court today charged.

The 77-year-old man's brother had found his body at an apartment complex in Martintar, Nadi.

The matter was reported at the Nadi Police Station last Monday.

item.title: Police Internal Affairs probes alleged conduct of Sigatoka police officer
item.description: The Fiji Police Force's Internal Affairs Department is carrying out a preliminary investigation into the alleged conduct of a Sigatoka-based police officer and reported threats made against a female student. Police say the next course of action will be determined once the preliminary investigation has been completed.
item.content:encoded:
The Fiji Police Force's Internal Affairs Department is carrying out a preliminary investigation into the alleged conduct of a Sigatoka-based police officer and reported threats made against a female student.

Police say the next course of action will be determined once the preliminary investigation has been completed.

Police are appealing to anyone who may know the victim or have information that could assist with the investigation to come forward.

Members of the public can contact the Police toll-free line on 1681, Crime Stoppers on 919, or report the matter at their nearest police station.

The Fiji Police Force is also encouraging members of the public to use the 1681 toll-free number to report crimes, suspicious activities, complaints about service delivery, or concerns regarding the conduct of police officers.

item.title: Man charged over alleged taxi driver robbery in Nadi
item.description: A 43-year-old man has been charged with aggravated robbery after allegedly assaulting a taxi driver in Nadi and stealing his cash, mobile phone and vehicle, which was later found abandoned at Navakai Housing. Police say the alleged incident occurred last Friday, when the accused allegedly assaulted the 52-year-old taxi driver before robbing him.
item.content:encoded:
A 43-year-old man has been charged with aggravated robbery after allegedly assaulting a taxi driver in Nadi and stealing his cash, mobile phone and vehicle, which was later found abandoned at Navakai Housing.

Police say the alleged incident occurred last Friday, when the accused allegedly assaulted the 52-year-old taxi driver before robbing him.

They say the stolen vehicle was later recovered after it was found abandoned at Navakai Housing.

The accused has been charged with one count of aggravated robbery.

He is expected to appear in the Nadi Magistrates Court today.
